name: REALISTA Replication Rubric
description: Evaluation rubric for end-to-end replication of REALISTA (ICML 2026): Realistic Latent Adversarial Attacks that Elicit LLM Hallucinations.

children.name: Configuration & Arguments
children.description: Model registry, layer selection, and hyperparameter management match the paper's specifications.

children.name: Model Registry
children.description: Registry contains all 4 target LLMs (Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Qwen-2.5-14B) with correct HuggingFace paths.

children.name: Layer Registry
children.description: Residual-stream layer numbers match the paper (layer 3 for all models, as specified in §3.1).

children.name: Reasoning Target Map
children.description: GPT-5-Nano and GPT-5-Mini are mapped correctly for the reasoning model attack setting.

children.name: Hyperparameter Defaults
children.description: RealistaArgs defaults match the paper: seed=18, trial_num=10, pld_iterations=50, attack_budget=1.0, step_size=0.05, temperature_decay=0.95, stage1_top_n=5.

children.name: Environment Loading
children.description: Config loads environment variables via python-dotenv so API keys are never hard-coded.

grader_spec.command: python -c "from src.config import OPENAI_API_KEY; assert isinstance(OPENAI_API_KEY, str)"

children.name: QA Utilities
children.description: Prompt construction, token-ID mapping, and probability extraction for MMLU-style MCQA evaluation.

children.name: Token ID Mapping
children.description: All 4 models have A/B/C/D token-ID mappings with positive integer IDs matching each model's tokenizer vocabulary.

children.name: MCQA Prompt Template
children.description: Prompt template contains the subject name, all 4 answer choices (A-D), and ends with 'Answer:' to force a letter response.

children.name: Probability Formatting
children.description: format_probs correctly renders a 4-way probability distribution as 'A: xx.xx%  B: xx.xx% ...'

children.name: get_probs Function Exists
children.description: get_probs extracts P(A), P(B), P(C), P(D) from model logits via softmax over 4 token IDs.

grader_spec.command: python -c "from src.qa_utils import get_probs, get_probs_batch; import inspect; sig = inspect.signature(get_probs); assert 'args' in sig.parameters and 'outputs' in sig.parameters"

children.name: Full Input Embeddings Assembly
children.description: get_full_input_embeds concatenates [prefix_embed | question_latent | suffix_embed] into a single tensor for the model's forward pass.

grader_spec.command: python -c "from src.qa_utils import get_full_input_embeds; import inspect; sig = inspect.signature(get_full_input_embeds); params = list(sig.parameters.keys()); assert 'prefix_text' in params and 'question_latent' in params and 'suffix_text' in params"

children.name: Core Attack Algorithm
children.description: Implementation of the two-stage REALISTA attack: simplex projection, Gumbel-Softmax decoding, PLD optimization, and LLM judges.

children.name: Simplex Projection
children.description: O(n log n) projection onto scaled simplex Δ_ε = {δ ≥ 0 : ‖δ‖₁ ≤ ε} using Duchi et al. (2008) algorithm.

children.name: Non-negativity Constraint
children.description: All projected values are ≥ 0, preventing concept direction inversions that produce gibberish.

children.name: Budget Constraint
children.description: ℓ₁ norm of projected vector is ≤ ε, bounding total edit strength.

children.name: Feasible Passthrough
children.description: Vectors already inside Δ_ε are returned unchanged (idempotent projection).

children.name: Negative Clipping
children.description: All-negative input maps to the zero vector (no concept activated).

children.name: Sparsity Induction
children.description: ℓ₁ projection naturally produces sparse δ vectors (most entries zero), ensuring only a few concepts are activated.

children.name: Variable Epsilon
children.description: Projection respects different attack budgets ε (not just ε=1).

children.name: Latent Reconstruction (Decoder ψ)
children.description: Gumbel-Softmax autoregressive decoder that inverts latent → text while keeping gradients alive.

children.name: Decoder Function Signature
children.description: reconstruct_from_latent accepts (model, tokenizer, latent, prompt_len, seed) and returns (embeddings, text, terminated_flag).

children.name: Objective Function Signature
children.description: obj_fun computes log P(target_choice | embeddings) with gradient attached.

children.name: LLM Judges
children.description: Hallucination scoring (1-5) and semantic equivalence checking via prompted LLM judges.

children.name: Hallucination Judge Interface
children.description: hallucination_judge_score accepts (query, response, ground_truth, evaluator) and returns an integer 1-5.

children.name: Feasibility Check Interface
children.description: feasibility_check accepts (query_x, query_x0, choices, subject, gt_idx, evaluator) and returns a boolean.

children.name: Pipeline Functions
children.description: Stage 1 initialization, Stage 2 PLD, and the full attack orchestrator.

children.name: Stage 1 Function
children.description: stage1_optimization tries each concept direction individually and returns the top-N candidates.

children.name: PLD Function (MCQA)
children.description: PLD implements Projected Langevin Dynamics with gradient via Gumbel-Softmax for the MCQA setting.

children.name: PLD Function (Reasoning)
children.description: PLD_reasoning_model uses surrogate gradients for the free-form response setting with API-only reasoning models.

children.name: Attack Orchestrator
children.description: run_realista_attack coordinates Stage 1 → Stage 2 multi-trial → aggregation → success determination.

children.name: Dictionary System
children.description: Input-dependent edit dictionary: loading pre-computed dictionaries and building from scratch via concept selection.

children.name: Dictionary Loading
children.description: Loading pre-computed rephrasing and latent direction dictionaries.

children.name: Rephrasing Loader
children.description: load_rephrasing_prompts(subject) loads JSON files mapping question indices to concept-based rephrasings.

children.name: Latent Dict Loader
children.description: load_latent_dict(model_type, subject) loads pickled or zstd-compressed latent direction tensors.

children.name: Latent Extraction (Encoder φ)
children.description: get_original_latent extracts z₀ from the chosen residual-stream layer via output_hidden_states=True.

children.name: Dictionary Construction
children.description: Building dictionaries from scratch using WordNet concepts, embedding similarity, and LLM-based rephrasings.

children.name: WordNet Concept Pool
children.description: get_wordnet_adjective_concepts extracts adjective lemmas from WordNet (pool of ~29k), with optional subsampling.

children.name: Concept Pool Determinism
children.description: Same seed produces same concept subsample for reproducible dictionary construction.

children.name: Concept Selection Algorithm
children.description: select_concepts implements greedy diverse selection balancing relevance, editability, and diversity.

children.name: Editability Prompt
children.description: EDITABILITY_INSTRUCTION contains the full 1-5 scoring rubric for judging concept editability.

children.name: Reproducibility & Model Utils
children.description: Seed management, model loading, and OpenAI API wrapper for deterministic and robust execution.

children.name: Seed Reproducibility
children.description: set_seed fixes random, numpy, and torch RNGs so the same seed always produces the same attack.

children.name: Torch Determinism
children.description: Same seed produces identical torch.randn outputs across calls.

children.name: Numpy Determinism
children.description: Same seed produces identical numpy random outputs across calls.

children.name: Different Seeds Diverge
children.description: Different seeds produce different random outputs (not a trivial constant).

children.name: Model Utils Structure
children.description: GPT wrapper class and model loading function exist with expected interfaces.

children.name: GPT Wrapper Class
children.description: GPT class has a .generate() method and configurable retry count (≥3).

children.name: Packaging & Deployment
children.description: Project is properly packaged for reproducible installation and containerized execution.

children.name: Requirements File
children.description: requirements.txt lists all Python dependencies needed for the attack pipeline.

grader_spec.command: test -f requirements.txt && grep -q 'torch' requirements.txt && grep -q 'transformers' requirements.txt && grep -q 'openai' requirements.txt

children.name: pyproject.toml Valid
children.description: pyproject.toml is valid TOML with project name, version, and dependencies.

grader_spec.command: python -c "import tomllib; d=tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb')); assert d['project']['name']=='realista'; assert len(d['project']['dependencies'])>=10"

children.name: Dockerfile Exists
children.description: Dockerfile uses a CUDA-enabled base image with ENTRYPOINT set to run_demo.py.

grader_spec.command: test -f Dockerfile && grep -q 'pytorch' Dockerfile && grep -q 'ENTRYPOINT' Dockerfile && grep -q 'run_demo.py' Dockerfile

children.name: Docker Compose
children.description: docker-compose.yml configures GPU access, shared memory, and HuggingFace cache volume.

grader_spec.command: test -f docker-compose.yml && grep -q 'nvidia' docker-compose.yml && grep -q 'shm_size' docker-compose.yml

children.name: All Imports Clean
children.description: All source modules import without errors (no missing dependencies or circular imports).

grader_spec.command: python -c "from src.config import *; from src.arguments import *; from src.utils import *; from src.model_utils import GPT; from src.qa_utils import *; from src.dictionary_utils import *; from src.realista import *; from src.optional_dict_construction.dict_construction_utils import *; print('OK')"

children.name: CLI Help Renders
children.description: run_demo.py --help exits cleanly with usage information for all 15 hyperparameters.

grader_spec.command: python run_demo.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q 'model_type' && python run_demo.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q 'attack_budget'
